item.title: The sweetness of Malta depends on the sweetness of our hearts, Archbishop says in Midnight Mass
item.description: Archbishop Charles Scicluna says Maltese society remains one in which mutual kindness is valued but urged that this should be lived not only in Malta’s international role as a promoter of peace in the Mediterranean, but also within communities and families

item.title: US airstrikes hit Islamic State targets in Nigeria
item.description: US President Donald Trump announces ‘powerful and deadly’ airstrikes against Islamic militants in Nigeria

item.title: Archaeological assessment for Qrendi site delayed until after zoning approval
item.description: The Superintendence for Cultural Heritage has delayed a full archaeological assessment of the land behind Qrendi Primary School until after planning parameters are approved for a pending zoning application

item.title: Pharma reform must lead to real access for patients | Corinne Zaffarese Elbourne
item.description: This long-overdue pledge for reform is a win for all patients struggling to access better medicines when they need them most

item.title: A year of steady progress
item.description: The work done this year continues to build on previous efforts and creates a stronger base for what lies ahead

item.title: Pauline Fenech: Life presents a stark choice—get busy living or get busy dying
Law enforcement officers collect and distribute food to those in need
item.description: Initiative, now in its sixth year, sees members of the disciplined forces deliver food supplies to children’s homes and social centres across Malta

item.title: Alcohol consumption stable as tobacco use continues to decline, survey finds
item.description: General Population Survey shows changing patterns in substance use, with increases in alcohol consumption among women and continued concerns over risky drinking

item.title: WATCH | L-Istrina collects €5.7 million in aid of Community Chest Fund
item.description: Over €5.7 million donated during 30th edition of annual Boxing Day fundraiser

item.title: Developers insist on seven floors on mega rationalisation site in Swatar
item.description: Developers are insisting on a building height of 22 metres, the equivalent of seven floors, on a large site in Swatar that was added to the development zones in 2006
